blocks.content: This concluding chapter consolidates Delhi's tourism circuit, key personalities, and every important numeric/name fact from the earlier chapters into one place for rapid last-minute revision.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Explores the primary tourism circuits highlighting Delhi's rich architectural and cultural heritage.
Details key historical and modern personalities who shaped Delhi's development and legacy.
Serves as a comprehensive one-line quick facts compendium tailored for rapid revision.

cells: Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Chandni Chowk, Khari Baoli spice market, Raj Ghat
Rashtrapati Bhavan, Sansad Bhavan, India Gate, National War Memorial, Rajpath/Kartavya Path
Qutub Minar complex, Humayun's Tomb, Lodi Gardens, Purana Qila, Safdarjung's Tomb
Lotus Temple, Akshardham Temple, Gurdwara Bangla Sahib, ISKCON Temple
National Museum, National Gallery of Modern Art, National Rail Museum, National Science Centre
Chauhan ruler who expanded Lal Kot into Qila Rai Pithora, the first of the 'Seven Cities'; defeated by Muhammad of Ghor in 1192
Last Mughal emperor; symbolic leader of the 1857 Revolt in Delhi; exiled to Rangoon after its suppression
First Chief Minister of Delhi (Part C State era, 1952-55)
Longest-serving Chief Minister of Delhi (INC, 1998-2013), associated with major infrastructure expansion including the Delhi Metro's early phases
Founder of the Aam Aadmi Party; Chief Minister of Delhi (2013 briefly, then 2015-2024), architect of the free electricity/water and Mohalla Clinic schemes
Current (2026) Chief Minister of Delhi, 9th CM and 4th woman CM, in office since 20 February 2025
Current (2026) Lieutenant Governor of Delhi, former Indian Ambassador to the United States, in office since 11 March 2026

items: Delhi (NCT): ~1,484 sq km; borders only Haryana and Uttar Pradesh; sits on the Yamuna's west bank.
Delhi Ridge = northernmost Aravalli extension, the 'green lungs of Delhi'.
Distinguish Delhi (NCT) vs New Delhi (capital area) vs NCR (larger multi-state region).
'Seven Cities of Delhi': Lal Kot/Qila Rai Pithora, Siri, Tughlaqabad, Jahanpanah, Firozabad, Purana Qila/Dinpanah, Shahjahanabad.
Delhi Sultanate (1206-1526): Mamluk, Khalji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, Lodi dynasties.
1526 First Battle of Panipat (Babur founds Mughal rule); 1556 Second Battle of Panipat (Akbar consolidates it).
1857 Revolt centred on Delhi; Bahadur Shah Zafar exiled to Rangoon.
1911 Delhi Durbar announces capital shift from Calcutta; New Delhi inaugurated 13 Feb 1931.
Delhi = Part C State (1950-56, brief Assembly) -> plain UT with NO Assembly (1956-91) -> NCT under Article 239AA (from 1 Feb 1992).
3 'excluded subjects' outside Delhi Assembly's power: Public Order, Police, Land.

2018 SC verdict limits LG's independent power; May 2023 SC verdict gives Services to Delhi govt; GNCTD (Amendment) Act 2023 creates National Capital Civil Service Authority, restoring LG-weighted control.
Only 3 UTs with Assembly + CM: Delhi, Puducherry, J&K.
70-seat Assembly (BJP 48, AAP 22, 2025); 7 Lok Sabha seats (all BJP); 3 Rajya Sabha seats.
Current CM: Rekha Gupta (BJP), since 20 Feb 2025. Current LG: Taranjit Singh Sandhu, since 11 March 2026.
3 local bodies: MCD (bulk of NCT), NDMC (Lutyens' zone, largely nominated), Delhi Cantonment Board.
MCD trifurcated 2012, re-unified May 2022; is India's largest municipal corporation.
Services-dominated economy; among India's highest per-capita income UTs.
Khari Baoli = Asia's largest wholesale spice market.
Population ~1.68 crore (2011); among the highest population density of any Indian state/UT (~11,300/sq km); ~97-98% urban.
Tourism circuits in Delhi, including UNESCO World Heritage Sites, are frequently tested in preliminary exams.
Historical personalities linked to Delhi's various dynasties and modern administration are high-yield topics.
One-line quick facts are critical for direct, objective-type general knowledge questions.
3 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb, Red Fort Complex.
New Parliament Building inaugurated 2023, alongside the original Sansad Bhavan.
GRAP (4 stages) manages air-quality emergencies; CAQM (2021 Act) coordinates cross-state pollution policy.
Yamuna's Delhi stretch is heavily polluted; toxic Chhath Puja foam is an iconic recurring image.
Revise this chapter last - it consolidates every numeric/name fact from Chapters 1-11 in one place for rapid recall.
The single most exam-critical topic in this entire book is the LG-vs-CM constitutional tussle (Chapter 4) - revise the 2018 verdict, May 2023 verdict, and the 2023 Amendment Act sequence carefully.
Always verify current officeholders (LG, CM, Deputy CM, Speaker) closer to your exam date, since Delhi's political landscape has changed rapidly in recent years.
